mapper.update: UPDATE data_sync_status SET status = #{status}, success_count = #{successCount}, fail_count = #{failCount}, message = #{message}, sync_time = #{syncTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO data_sync_status ( data_type, trade_date, status, success_count, fail_count, message, sync_time ) VALUES
( #{item.dataType}, #{item.tradeDate}, #{item.status}, #{item.successCount}, #{item.failCount}, #{item.message}, #{item.syncTime} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), success_count = VALUES(success_count), fail_count = VALUES(fail_count), message = VALUES(message), sync_time = VALUES(sync_time)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM data_sync_status ORDER BY sync_time DESC, trade_date DESC, data_type
